title: Waystar Reports Q3 2026 Revenue of $325.6 Million, Up 21%
summary: Waystar reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $325.6 million, up 21% year over year, and net income of $31.0 million, and gave full-year 2026 guidance.
body_markdown:
Subscription revenue was $180.7 million, up 34% year over year, and volume-based revenue was $142.9 million, up 8%. Provider revenue was $243.4 million, up 28%, and patient revenue was $82.2 million, up 5%. The company said 1,488 clients contributed over $100,000 in last-twelve-month revenue, up 14% year over year, and reported a net revenue retention rate of 108%.


For full fiscal year 2026, Waystar said it expects total revenue between $1.277 billion and $1.287 billion, adjusted EBITDA between $543 million and $549 million, non-GAAP net income between $322 million and $337 million, and diluted non-GAAP net income per share between $1.63 and $1.71.


## Why It Matters for WAY


The company tied the quarter to client demand. "Waystar delivered another quarter of robust bookings and healthy demand across the business," Chief Executive Officer Matt Hawkins said in the release. He added that providers are "increasingly consolidating more of the revenue cycle onto Waystar's connected platform" as they adopt more of its AI-powered capabilities.
